hero.description: Join a movement of young African leaders building technical fluency in Bitcoin, blockchain, and open-source technology - in your language, at your pace.

what.label: What We're Building
what.title: Africa's Language-First Bitcoin Education Network
what.description: Libreria de Satoshi is Africa's premier Bitcoin education and ambassador program. We're building a self-sustaining network of young African leaders who master Bitcoin and blockchain technology - and multiply that knowledge across their communities.
what.quote: "Through cohort-based learning, hands-on training, and mentorship, we transform ambitious learners into confident educators and community leaders."

reach.title: Continent-Wide Reach
reach.description: A pan-African program designed to reach every corner of the continent, crossing language barriers and borders to multiply knowledge.

knowledge.title: Deep Technical Knowledge
knowledge.description: Bitcoin fundamentals, Computer Science, open-source tools, cryptography, coding, economics, and AI - all in one structured curriculum.

community.title: Community Growth
community.description: Transform from learner to educator. Build a lasting legacy in your community by becoming the local Bitcoin knowledge hub.

goal.label: Our Goal
goal.description: Empower a generation of African Bitcoin ambassadors who understand blockchain technology deeply, lead their communities with confidence, and shape the future of finance on the continent.
goal.pillars: Our ambassadors learn and teach across six core pillars:
goal.footer: Knowledge multiplies across borders and languages

why.label: Why This Matters
why.description: Bitcoin education in Africa is growing - but it's not enough. Your communities need leaders who understand blockchain deeply. Build the future on the continent.
why.quotePrefix: "Knowledge that stays in one language stays in one place.

gap.title: The Gap Is Real
gap.description: Bitcoin adoption in Africa is growing fast, but deep technical education lags behind. Most content is in English and inaccessible to millions of young Africans.

languages.title: Local Languages Matter
languages.description: Education should live within communities, in the languages people think in. Knowledge taught in your mother tongue sticks, grows, and spreads.

teachers.title: Africa Needs Teachers
teachers.description: Your communities need leaders who understand blockchain deeply. The most powerful thing you can do is become a teacher - and Africa needs you now.

how.label: How It Works
how.description: A structured, step-by-step program designed to take you from Bitcoin beginner to community educator in a matter of months.

one.title: Cohort-Based Learning
one.description: Join a cohort of peers from across Africa. Learn together, support each other, and progress through structured modules with expert guidance.

two.title: Hands-On Technical Training
two.description: Practice with real Bitcoin tools and open-source software. Build actual skills - not just theory - through guided labs and projects.

three.title: Leadership & Localization
three.description: Develop communication and facilitation skills. Learn to adapt Bitcoin concepts to your culture, language, and community context.

four.title: Knowledge Sharing
four.description: Organize local workshops, online sessions, and community meetups. Multiply your learning by teaching others in your network.

five.title: Proof of Work Funnel
five.description: Document your impact. Complete milestones, earn recognition, and build a track record that proves your leadership and expertise.

benefits.label: What You Get
benefits.description: Everything you need to become a confident Bitcoin educator - at no cost to you.
benefits.curriculumDescription: Our curriculum covers everything a modern Bitcoin ambassador needs - from first principles to hands-on technical skills. All taught in your language, at your pace.

certified.title: Certified Educator
certified.description: Earn an official certification that recognizes you as a qualified Bitcoin and open-source educator across Africa.

earnAsYouLearn.title: Earn as You Learn
earnAsYouLearn.description: Receive financial rewards, access to grants, and economic benefits for your active participation and contributions throughout the program.

internships.title: Paid Internships
internships.description: Top performers get access to paid internship opportunities within the technology and open-source ecosystem.

globalOpportunities.title: Global Opportunities
globalOpportunities.description: Scholarships and invitations to international Bitcoin & tech conferences, events, and residencies worldwide.

enrollment.label: Apply Today
enrollment.title: Ready to Join?
enrollment.description: Start the ambassador application - it takes about 5-15 minutes. Your progress is saved automatically on this device.
enrollment.cardTitle: Full application in four short steps
enrollment.cardDescription: Personal details, guardian consent if you are under 18, your availability and commitment, and your Bitcoin experience. Answer in your own words - authenticity matters.
enrollment.questionsSuffix: with "Ambassador Question" in the subject line.

footer.description: Building Africa's language-first, learner-to-educator Bitcoin network. Knowledge that multiplies across borders.

application.label: Ambassador application
application.title: Africa Bitcoin Education
application.description: Complete all required fields. This takes about 5-15 minutes. Do not use AI tools to answer - we want your authentic voice.
